definitions.gloss: gallstone; hard deposit forming in the gallbladder
definitions.explanation: A hardened deposit of digestive fluid that can form in the gallbladder or bile ducts. Gallstones can cause severe abdominal pain and may require surgical removal.

examples.japanese: {胆石|たんせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
{胆石|たんせき}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{激痛|げきつう}→激痛：17165_gekitsuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I called an ambulance because of severe pain from a gallstone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胆石|たんせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{摘出|てきしゅつ}→摘出：29095_tekishutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: A gallstone was discovered during a health checkup, and it was decided that it would be removed surgically.

notes:
{胆|たん} refers to the gallbladder; {石|せき} means stone. Gallstones are a relatively common condition in adults.
